description: This file contains unit tests for the JacksonSerializationContext class, verifying behaviors related to JSON generator creation, buffer writing, and output stream handling in the context of Jackson serialization.

classes.name: JacksonSerializationContextIT
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing JacksonSerializationContext behaviors.

methods.name: jsonGeneratorIsCreatedByFactory
methods.description: Tests that the JSON generator is created by the factory and that the correct generator is returned.

methods.name: createdWithTargetBufferWritesToBuffer
methods.description: Verifies that writing with a ByteBuffer target buffer results in data being written to the buffer.

methods.name: createdWithOutputStreamWritersToStream
methods.description: Checks that writing via an OutputStream writes data to the stream, as indicated by the flag.
